title: ScheduleCreateArguments
description: The arguments of the `schedule_create` tool (`pipeshub@schedules/create`, ADR-SCH-01 D2): the schedule as its person sees it on the approval card, and exactly what `POST /api/v1/agent-harness/internal/runs/{runId}/schedules` accepts as `arguments`. The worker validates a call against this before it asks the person, so nobody approves a call Node then refuses. Shape and lengths only (lengths in code points, the strings as sent, never trimmed): whether `at` is a date on the calendar, at least 60 seconds and at most 366 days ahead, whether a time zone is known and whether a cron parses and fires at most every 5 minutes are checked in code, by Node at create.

name.description: The schedule's name; not only spaces.

ask.description: What each run is asked, written so it stands alone; not only spaces.

at.description: An ISO 8601 instant with its offset (`Z` or `±hh:mm`), seconds optional, at most 3 fractional digits.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`; whether it is known is checked in code.
An IANA time zone name, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`; whether it is known is checked in code.

when.description: One of the two kinds: `kind` tells them apart, so at most one branch ever matches.

notify.description: Where the person hears that a run ended; absent: in the app. Never null.

examples.name: Joke in five minutes
examples.ask: Tell me a short, clean joke.
